verdict.rationale: Zoho Books exposes agent-drivable reconciliation primitives through its API: categorizing uncategorized transactions, creating and listing bank reconciliations, bank statement summaries, and Bank Rules with match filters. Zoho MCP connects Claude/GPT agents to Books, and a vendor-quoted customer says month-end closures dropped 'from hours to minutes.' However, nothing documents an agent running a full month-end reconciliation, flagging exceptions, or preparing a close package for review. The Books MCP capability list names invoices, payments, expenses and reports, not reconciliation. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end agent reconciliation workflow, explicit transaction-matching tools in MCP, agent-driven exception flagging (Zia anomaly spotting is only a marketing line), a close-preparation and human-review handoff, and independent hands-on corroboration.
